page.layout: One page of text in a single column; marginal notes in the right margin, beside the lines of the first two paragraphs and the paragraph beginning "Contra". Running head at top centre with page number at top right.

main_text.p: tatis, tum eruditionis specimen, adeo impurè tractant, à quo plerique tamen hauserunt, qua in linguis sciunt, ut non obiurgatione, sed execratione dignum sit, hoc pacto ἀντιπλαςγεῖν.

LUTHERUS ubi rescivit Carolostadium Argentinae Wharerę, prolixam ad Argentinenses scribit epistolam, qua illis lucem doctrinae Evangelicae gratulatur, eosdemq; ad constantiam & concordiam, & ad tolerandas calumnias, iniurias & infestationes hortatur: inprimis autem, à Carolostadii veneno sibi caveant, monet, renovatā memoriā colloquii Orlamundici, quo in loco Carolostadiani etiam vitae suae essent insidiati.Tom. 3. oper. Germ. Jen. Ec Tom. 1. epist. Luth.

Contra, Argentinenses Gregorium Caseliū, Hebraicae linguae Professorem, VVitteberg-gam mittunt, rogatum, ut ne Lutherus charitatem fraternam & unionem Ecclesiae propter controversiā Eucharisticā violet, Zwinglium & Oecolampadium, viros doctos & integros pro fratrib. agnoscat: de coena scribat & edoceat, quae vera esse credat. Quibus Lutherus per Caselium respondet: pace nihil esse optabilius: silere aut perpetuo, non esse integrum: respondere non posse, si damnari non liceat: & damnandi verbum pro convitio rapiatur: se à modestissimis illis, ut carnivoram, & esculenti Dei, impanatiq; cultorem traduci: consilium Argentinensium sibi non probari, quod fideles avocandi sint, à quaestione corpo-Tom. 2. epist Luth. pag. 392.

page.notes: Marginal notes right: "Tom. 3. oper. Germ. Jen. Ec", "Tom. 1. epist. Luth.", "Tom. 2. epist Luth. pag. 392." Woodcut-like mark after "Argentinae" is a printer's ornament; the word is read as "Wharerę" (haerere) with doubt. Google digitiser watermark at lower right omitted.
